parent_objective: design bounded four-wheel source viability calibration after high-regret rows are collision dominated
blocked_by: M1269 admits own-branch viability calibration as the next source variable

public_gates: M1270 must preserve actor input contract
M1270 must not use private holdout
M1270 must design a new viability variable without threshold relaxation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel/fault labels to actor inputs
do not treat collision-dominated rows as source-positive
do not revert to horizon-only success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the next source variable after M1268 shows high regret but own-branch nonviability
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, source-positive, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design lowers accepted thresholds
stop if design relies on horizon-only success
stop if design cannot report collision dominance separately
fallback_plan: if viable high-regret rows require scenario retargeting, admit one bounded retarget smoke
if action candidates are the limiting factor, admit one bounded sequence calibration smoke
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1269 identifies own-branch viability as the next source blocker

allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next implementation manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: design pre-registers a bounded smoke if admitted

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1270 designs source viability calibration and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Use M1269 audit to change the source variable to viability rather than repeating the same high-collision grid.
allowed_claims: no source-positive, recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A bounded viability calibration design can preserve M1268's high-regret signal while targeting own-branch viability under unchanged thresholds.
success_criteria: design preserves success semantics and strict thresholds
design pre-registers one bounded implementation if admitted
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design treats horizon-only rows as success
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1270 passes if it designs one bounded four-wheel viability calibration smoke with strict thresholds and no actor-input expansion.
